svg.text: 00_TOP: llm_soc / Quartus memory binding
18 pt = 24 px. Thin arrows: instantiation. Thick arrows: traced functional ports. Dashed blocks: external library.
TOP
(llm_soc)
External host: host_en / host_we / host_addr[31:0] / host_wdata[31:0]
Return: host_ready / host_rdata[31:0]. Hold request until ACK; deassert enable between transactions.
Status: running / ready / error / overflow_out. Debug: pc_debug[8:0] / instr_debug[12:0].
Clock/reset: clk / rst_n. This is an internal request/acknowledge interface; AXI/APB are not implemented.
Block Functions & Interfaces
llm_soc: Host frontend and autonomous graph; parent muxes, operand caches, scaling, softmax/V pass,
vector writes and token selection.
TOP
Parameters: USE_QUARTUS_MEMORY=1, PERF_COUNTERS=0, ENABLE_DEBUG_INDEX=0, ATTN_DIV_LANES=4,
SIGMOID_LANES=4
Source: llm_soc.sv:3
Configuration: USE_QUARTUS_MEMORY=1, ATTN_DIV_LANES=4, SIGMOID_LANES=4.
PERF_COUNTERS=0 and ENABLE_DEBUG_INDEX=0. Other configurations require a separate expansion.
USE_SHARED=1: normalizer lane zero is connected to top u_div; only lanes 1, 2, 3 are children.
Packages are source context, not instances. Generate scopes are annotations, not modules.
Alternate memory hierarchy: see rtl_hierarchy_portable.drawio. Quartus is a demonstration backend.
